exercises.prompt: Select the correct case in an incomplete negative clause ('No one came except Zayd'):
exercises.explanation: In an incomplete negative clause, إِلَّا is transparent ('only'), and زَيْدٌ takes the nominative case as the fāʿil of جَاءَ.

feedback.rule: Incomplete negative exception: assign the case demanded by the verb.

exercises.prompt: What case does a noun take after غَيْرَ or سِوَى ('other than Zayd')?
exercises.explanation: غَيْرَ and سِوَى are nouns acting as muḍāf, so the following noun is always genitive (muḍāf ilayh).

feedback.rule: Nouns after غَيْر and سِوَى are always genitive (majrūr).
